text:
Jordan P: ok team — we need a lightweight rollout for the new OSS 'tiny-ref' tutorial playlist this week. goal: quick wins for devs, low production overhead.
Maria S: love it. idea: 3x 90s snack videos + a single PR-ready reference app in the repo.
Alex K: can do the reference app. i'll slice an existing example and make it 'plug-and-play' with a one-file config. ETA 48h.
Tanvi R: I'll own the snack vids and tweet copy. want to keep messaging focused on 'production-ready inference patterns' and cost/latency wins.
Jordan P: perfect. draft promo cadence: day 1 repo + blog short, day 2 snack vids + threads, day 3 livestream AMA (30m). keep CTAs to 'try the repo' + 'join the AMA'.
Maria S: suggested blog outline in Slack: 1) problem statement, 2) how tiny-ref maps to Redwood runtimes, 3) quickstart (3 commands), 4) sample results and perf bullets.
Alex K: quickstart snippet i'll include in README: ```
# clone
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/tiny-ref && cd tiny-ref
# run locally with docker
./run_local.sh --model mosaicml/mpt-7b
```
Tanvi R: proposed tweet thread draft: "1/ Tiny-ref: a mini reference app for production inference on Redwood. 2/ Quickstart in <2 mins. 3/ Works with Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Try: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tiny-ref" thoughts? :rocket:
Jordan P: tweak to call out benchmarking: add a line about median latency and token cost per call. that'll feed into benchmark narrative we can reuse.
Maria S: i'll add a 3-bullet benchmark snapshot to the blog: p50=120ms @ 512 tokens, cost ~ $0.003/token with batching config X. (these are placeholders — we'll update after Alex's run)
Alex K: running perf now on an rtx A5000; will paste numbers. small ask: can devrel-bot upload the demo GIF to CDN once i push?
devrel-bot: @Alex K reminder queued — when you push a tag "v0.1.0" I will auto-generate a GIF from the workflow and upload to /cdn/tiny-ref/v0.1.0/.
Tanvi R: media plan: 1) blog post + repo, 2) twitter + linkedin threads, 3) community newsletter mention, 4) 30min AMA next week. need speakers and a TOC for the AMA.
Jordan P: speakers: Alex (demo + perf), Tanvi (why this matters for devs), Maria (marketing + CTAs). Tanvi can pick an audience Q set.
Maria S: inbound lead routing: capture a short form in README linking to demo deploy. route form submissions to the community list (marketing@redwood.com) and tag "oss-playlist". Ops: we need a simple Zapier flow.
Alex K: i'll add the form in PR as a static HTML + netlify form action. PR will include instructions.
Tanvi R: creatives: I need a 16:9 GIF, 1:1 snippet for IG, and the repo hero screenshot. Alex — can you commit a 16:9 demo recording?
Alex K: yes. will add demo.mp4 and a tiny script to export GIF.
Jordan P: legal/security check: no customer data, it's all synthetic. still cc @security but looks fine.
Maria S: timeline recap: Mon AM — PR + blog draft, Mon PM — snack vids and assets, Tue — social + newsletter, Wed — AMA prep, Thu — AMA.
Tanvi R: tagging weekly calendar: i put a tentative slot Wed 16:00 PT for the AMA.
Alex K: perf numbers: p50=128ms @ 256 tokens batching=4 on A5000, cost estimate ~$0.0025/token with quantized model. pushing PR now.
Jordan P: awesome — Maria/Tanvi can finalize copy with those numbers. last check: anyone disagree on the low-friction approach?
Maria S: no objections. keeping it small will help velocity.
Tanvi R: agreed. i'll draft social copy and drop it here for approval.
Jordan P: great work — everyone share PR link + assets here when ready and i'll schedule the blog publish. :tada:"
